name: Dayo Prochazka-Sillah
role: Loan shark and bookmaker operating a numbers game in the Narrows
location: The Narrows — runs his business from a rotating set of tea houses and noodle stalls in the Burnside Pocket neighborhood, near Damen and Armitage
description:
Dayo is a large man running toward fat but not there yet, with a warm brown complexion, a magnificent graying mustache he waxes into points, and the kind of patient, heavy-lidded expression that could mean he's bored or that he's calculating what you're worth in pieces. He has a geneware modification he got in his thirties — his irises shift between deep amber and a vivid green-gold depending on his mood, which he claims is useful for business ('People watch my eyes. They miss my hands.'). He favors well-made but not flashy clothing: real fabric, subtle patterns, shoes that are always clean. He smells of cardamom and whatever tea he's most recently finished.

Dayo came up through the numbers game as a runner himself, at sixteen, and has never romanticized it. He is pleasant in the specific way of people who have learned that pleasant is more effective than threatening for roughly eighty percent of interactions, and who have made peace with the other twenty percent. He is genuinely fond of his regulars — he knows their families, their ailments, their lucky numbers — and this fondness does not prevent him from collecting. He has two enforcers he treats well and pays generously, and he refers to them as 'my associates' with the mild pride of a man who considers proper staffing a virtue.

core_fears: Being revealed as sentimental — he believes it would end him
Dying before he can retire somewhere quiet
core_desires: A legitimate business, eventually — something with a sign and a license
To be remembered as fair, within the context of what he is
coping_mechanisms: Ritual sociability — the tea, the rounds, the pleasantries are genuinely stabilizing
Compartmentalization: the warm Dayo and the collecting Dayo are kept in separate mental drawers
blind_spots: Believes his 'fairness' reputation is accurate when it is actually maintained by selective memory among people who can't afford to contradict him
Underestimates how much the younger generation of Burnside criminals resents his position
psychology.secret: He has been quietly forgiving the debts of three families in Burnside Pocket — people he's known for decades — writing them off his books and absorbing the loss personally. He would be humiliated if anyone discovered this generosity.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, idiomatic blend of Nigerian English, Czech-inflected vowels from his paternal grandmother's speech patterns, and Meridian street slang. Uses food metaphors frequently. Refers to money as 'weight.'
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, conversational, rarely raises his voice — the volume drop is the warning sign, not the volume rise.
verbal_tics: Clicks his tongue before declining something
'My friend' as an address that ranges from genuine to deeply ominous depending on context
example_lines: 'My friend, I am not a bank. A bank charges interest and then surprises you. I tell you everything up front. This is a courtesy.'
'You see what I mean? The number doesn't care who you are. That's the beauty of it. Very democratic.'

story_hooks: One of his longtime borrowers has vanished owing a significant sum — Dayo suspects foul play rather than a skip, and he wants the truth more than the money, which is itself suspicious
A corporate auditor from Tessera has started showing up at his establishments asking questions under the guise of regulatory inspection — someone has pointed them at Dayo specifically
narrative_function: Information hub, quest giver, creditor with power over multiple neighborhood characters — his loan book touches dozens of lives and creates cascading dependencies players can pull on.
augmentations: Mood-reactive iris geneware (amber to green-gold). A subdermal transaction chip in his left palm for discreet Quanta transfers — old model, slightly outdated but reliable. No other mods.
daily_life: Makes the rounds of three or four Burnside Pocket establishments each morning, collecting slips and settling the previous day's books. Afternoons for new loans and negotiations. Evenings he sits in one fixed location — whoever is hosting that week — and holds a kind of informal court.
affiliation: Semi-independent; pays protection to the Burnside Compact, a loose neighborhood criminal coalition; has operated long enough to have de facto seniority

decision_rules: Never lend to someone who can't name collateral — not for cruelty, for their protection, he says
Always have tea in hand during a difficult conversation — it gives everyone somewhere to look
Two warnings before consequences; one warning if the debtor has been rude
escalation_ladder: Friendly reminder with a mild extension offer
The associates attend the next meeting
Collection by whatever means are necessary, with personal regret expressed sincerely

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Affable and evaluative — charming until he's decided what category they fall into
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm, generously attentive, brings food without being asked

stress_responses.low: More tea, slower movements, a slight flattening of the warmth
stress_responses.medium: Goes very still and quiet; the mustache-twirling stops
stress_responses.high: Removes himself from the situation entirely to think, then returns with a decision already made — does not discuss it, just implements it

contradictions: Insists he is not sentimental while quietly carrying the weight of decades of neighborhood relationships that genuinely matter to him
habits: Waxes his mustache every morning as a meditative practice
Keeps a physical ledger in addition to digital records — 'The net goes down. Paper doesn't.'
breaking_points: Someone harming one of the families he's been quietly protecting — the warm Dayo would not survive that

timeline.event: Born in Burnside Pocket to a Yoruba-Czech transit worker family
Began running numbers at sixteen for the previous Burnside operator
Took over the book when his predecessor retired; established his current operation
Burnside Compact formed; Dayo became one of its founding voices
Actively considering what retirement might look like and whether it's possible for someone with his ledger

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'

physical_description.build: Large-framed, solid through the shoulders and chest, carrying weight with the ease of a man who has never pretended to be smaller than he is. A soft belly beginning, but the underlying mass is structural—not yet softness, but heading that direction with the patience of someone who doesn't rush anything.
physical_description.hair_style: Combed back from the forehead, kept neat and precise
physical_description.eye_color: Mood-reactive geneware: shifts between deep amber (neutral/calculating) and vivid green-gold (content/engaged). The transition is visible and smooth, a tell he long ago decided was useful.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with reddish undertones, the complexion of someone with West African heritage and extensive time spent indoors and in the temperate GLMZ climate
physical_description.complexion: Well-maintained despite his age. The skin around his eyes shows crow's feet from decades of calculated smiling. His face is broad, with a strong jawline partially obscured by his signature mustache—gray and dark brown mixed, waxed into precise points that curl slightly upward. No visible acne scarring or serious blemishes. His expression defaults to a patient, heavy-lidded look that could read as boredom or calculation depending on what his irises are doing at the moment.
distinguishing_marks: A thin white scar running from the left corner of his mouth toward his ear, approximately 4cm long, likely from a knife or broken glass twenty-five years ago. It tightens his smile slightly on that side.
A small, neat burn scar on the inside of his right wrist—old, faded to pale brown, roughly circular and 1cm across. Tool-related, not combat-related.

A faint tattoo on his left inner forearm: geometric patterns in dark gray, a design from the early 2190s that reads as dated but not regretted. It curves slightly with the motion of his muscle beneath.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Only the iris geneware is externally apparent—the color shifts draw attention precisely as Dayo intends. The transaction chip in his left palm is subcutaneous and invisible except under direct light, where a faint silver line is barely visible at the crease of his palm. He keeps that hand relaxed and unobtrusive.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with the deliberate, economical motion of someone for whom speed is not the point. His gait is steady and measured, shoulders slightly forward in a posture that seems to take up space without announcing it. He sits heavily but settles quickly, gesturing with his hands in conversational moments—calculated movement, nothing wasted. His hands are large, with blunt fingers and well-maintained nails. He uses them to illustrate a point rather than to intimidate.
physical_description.clothing_style: Real fabric, always: cotton blends, linen, lightweight wools appropriate to the climate. He favors muted earth tones—warm grays, deep browns, rust-tinged neutrals—and subtle geometric patterns in his shirts. His jackets are well-tailored but not ostentatious, worn to fit rather than to impress. His shoes are always clean leather, usually in dark brown or charcoal, polished to a soft shine. No visible corporate branding. His watch, when visible, is functional and expensive-looking but not new. He wears a simple gold band on his ring finger—whether for marriage or as a personal choice is immaterial to his presentation. A thin gold chain, barely visible, runs beneath his collar. He smells consistently of cardamom, black tea, and clean linen.
